critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 987 lines — repeat recommendation from iter1 to split into routers/.

GET /api/bookings/{bid} reveals owner_contact and pickup_address only when status in (confirmed, checked_in, completed) or admin — matches spec. Renter_contact also revealed to owner post-payment as expected.

PATCH /api/auth/profile uses model_dump() with None filtering — correctly does not overwrite unset fields; consider explicit exclude_unset=True for stronger semantic clarity when clients send explicit nulls to clear a field.
Admin vehicle detail returns plate_full for admin (unmasked) — verified. public_vehicle() still masks plate for non-admin/non-owner routes.
buildWaLink() in BookingDetails.jsx strips non-digits from phone (works for +55 48 99999-0002 → 5548999990002) and encodes the message correctly — verified via live HTTPS test.
AdminDashboard.jsx: filter tabs use data-testid admin-tab-{all|renter|owner|admin}; user rows admin-user-{id}; vehicle cards admin-veh-{id}. All present.
